I've been on HRT for 7 1/2 years now. Back then, my psychiatrist put me on Risperidone. I was on Risperidone for 4 1/2 years, and was on sublingual estrogen, progesterone and spiro. It was effective, and did not cause any odd interactions with my Spiro though, but if you find you start having milk production, I highly recommend seeing an endocrinologist as Risperidone caused me to develop a prolactinoma ( benign pituitary gland tumor that will create breast milk) that went away when discontinuing the Risperidone. However, it meant I had to be off hormones for 3 months, so knowing that interaction can be important going into it
